$comment: Rooms an office's page gives a person in words that no rule reads: one person, one room, the
page section that says so and its exact words. The build places the person in the room's
building (office_at) only while this run's capture of that section still holds the quote, the
person is the only node with that ID and name, and the room has a reviewed building prefix.
A person whose own profile or listing publishes a room is placed by it, never from here.

rooms.quote: Dean Benny Chan, School of Science, Nursing, and Health, Room ASB-422
rooms.note: Proposed 2026-11-03 under the OK to link what is sure; needs a person's confirmation. The Registrar's list of school deans gives Dean Benny Chan's room as ASB-422; their faculty profile and directory entry publish no room, and the Center for Student Success's SNH listing gives the school office the same room ("Office location: ASB422").
